summary: Swiss & High-Contrast landing-page redesign PASSED end-to-end frontend testing. All 43 required data-testids render in both LIGHT and DARK modes with zero console errors. Every interactive element in scope works: hero CTAs (primary → /auth/register?ref=hero_swiss, secondary → smooth-scroll to fee calc), fee calculator (slider updates $10k→$22.5k volume and $260→$585 savings; Stripe→PayPal switch updates alt-bar $743→$932 & 2.9%→3.49%; fee-calc-cta → /auth/register?ref=fee_calc), FAQ accordion (item-0 open by default, click item-2 → item-0 closes + item-2 opens with + rotating 45deg), product showcase (next/prev/dot-1 all change slide — elongated dot moves 34→8→34 and mock browser URL flips checkout↔dashboard), final CTA (register → /auth/register?ref=final_cta; docs → /documentation; chat button visible). Mobile 390×844: NO horizontal overflow, hero stacks (terminal y=847 below CTA y=507), stat-wall is 2×2 (2 distinct row tops), all 5 bento cards stack full-width 342px @ left=24. Regression: /fees, /auth/login, /auth/register all load. Header/footer intact on landing. Bento cards contain 0 tags — all UI mockups (checkout with coin pills, JS code block, dynopay.me link, transactions table, donation progress). Dark-mode contrast sampled: bento cards / fee-calc / stat-fee all ~19:1 (excellent). Only one design nit remains from iteration_23's known list.

design_issues.screen: Landing '/' LIGHT mode — hero mini-stats & captions
issues: Small labels 'Businesses' / 'Chains' / 'Avg settlement' (10.5px) and '// REAL SETTLEMENT FLOW · REPLAYED' (11px) render color=rgba(10,10,10,0.38) alpha-composited over rgb(238,241,246) → effective rgb(~151,~153,~156) on ~rgb(238,241,246) ≈ 2.4:1 contrast. Fails WCAG AA (needs 4.5:1 for small text). Same pattern found on hero '🇺🇸 Trusted by merchants…' caption. This is essentially the same class of issue iteration_23 flagged as 'MINOR / non-blocking' (was 4.27:1 for the medium captions); the tiny 10.5px labels are worse. Suggested fix: use theme.palette.text.secondary at ~rgba(10,10,10,0.62) or a resolved #5B5B66 to reach 4.5:1+.

action_items: OPTIONAL / accessibility polish: bump LIGHT-mode small captions from rgba(10,10,10,0.38) to ~rgba(10,10,10,0.62) (or resolved ~#5B5B66) on 'Businesses'/'Chains'/'Avg settlement' labels, hero '🇺🇸 Trusted by…' line, and '// REAL SETTLEMENT FLOW · REPLAYED' to reach WCAG AA 4.5:1. Currently ~2.4:1. Same class of issue iteration_23 called out; still non-blocking visually but sub-AA.
critical_code_review_comments: fee-calc-bar-dynopay height reflects fee-rate not volume — this is correct design, but the review's expectation 'the two bars … update' when the slider moves may confuse future testers. Consider adding a subtle numeric-count animation on the $ label inside the bar or a mini annotation ('bars show rate; label shows $ at your volume') to clarify.
Every landing CTA correctly threads a referral code (?ref=hero_swiss / fee_calc / final_cta) into /auth/register and the register page pre-fills the Referral Code field — nice attribution setup.
Bento cards are genuinely image-free (verified via query_selector_all('img').length===0) — no stock photos as required.
Consider adding aria-expanded to the FAQ button (currently only visual + rotation communicates state). Screen-reader users would benefit.

success_rate.frontend: 43/43 testids present · 12/12 flows verified · 3/3 regression pages load · 1 minor design nit (contrast on small light-mode captions, same class as iteration_23 known list)

seed_data_creation: None. Read-only. Only client-side localStorage 'theme-mode' toggled between 'light' and 'dark' (as instructed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Redesign is production-ready. Public URL from /app/frontend/.env is https://dynopay-preview-9.preview.emergentagent.com (NOT the URL in the review request text; that domain 404s from within the container). Theme via localStorage['theme-mode']='light'|'dark' + reload — the header theme-toggle button works but reload is faster/deterministic. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' for goto — networkidle times out because the ChainsMarquee animation keeps the raf/network signal busy. Fee calculator slider is a MUI Slider; focus its inner input[type=range] and ArrowRight to increment. Product showcase active dot is identified by width (elongated ~34px vs ~8px), not aria-current. FAQ open state is identified by .MuiCollapse-entered and the + icon transform rotate(45deg). All CTAs thread ?ref=... into /auth/register; register page pre-fills the Referral Code field with that value.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — redesign passes. The one remaining design nit (light-mode small-caption contrast at ~2.4:1) is the same class as iteration_23's known-minor issue and can be resolved by a one-line palette bump (alpha 0.38 → 0.62 on text.disabled or use text.secondary tokens for these labels).
